text: Unlike Godwit-7, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Bittern-8 is Elixir. Nobody should assume the language of Bittern-8 applies to Godwit-7, the language differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
All instances of Shrike-8 live in the datacenter at Quito.
Unlike Tern-4, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Shrike-8 is $1125k. Nobody should assume the budget of Shrike-8 applies to Tern-4, the budget differs.

Unlike Dunlin-6, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Plover-4 is 4150 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Plover-4 applies to Dunlin-6, the rate limit differs.
Dunlin-6 is implemented in Haskell; the language was chosen for its tooling.

Unlike Plover-4, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Tern-4 is $4440k. Nobody should assume the budget of Tern-4 applies to Plover-4, the budget differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

Unlike Plover-4, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Bittern-8 is February 20, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Bittern-8 applies to Plover-4, the retirement date differs. An older draft of this note was archived.

Unlike Dunlin-6, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Bittern-8 is the Osaka datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Bittern-8 applies to Dunlin-6, the datacenter differs.

Unlike Godwit-7, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Dunlin-6 is the Tessera team. Nobody should assume the owner of Dunlin-6 applies to Godwit-7, the owner differs. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

Unlike Bittern-8, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Tern-4 is February 8, 2028. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Tern-4 applies to Bittern-8, the retirement date differs.

Unlike Bittern-8, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Plover-4 is December 25, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Plover-4 applies to Bittern-8, the retirement date differs.
Questions about Godwit-7 start with its owner, the Anvil team; they triage anything filed against it. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
For Plover-4 the port is 2577. Changing the port needs a change ticket. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Shrike-8 is implemented in Scala; the language was chosen for its tooling.
Dunlin-6 enforces a rate limit of 400 requests per minute per caller.

Unlike Tern-4, whose pager rotation is handled elsewhere, the pager rotation of Godwit-7 is Gideon Jaramillo. Nobody should assume the pager rotation of Godwit-7 applies to Tern-4, the pager rotation differs.
The primary datacenter of Dunlin-6 is Quito; failover is handled by operations. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
Questions about Tern-4 start with its owner, the Sprocket team; they triage anything filed against it. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.

Unlike Plover-4, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Bittern-8 is 7981. Nobody should assume the port of Bittern-8 applies to Plover-4, the port differs. An older draft of this note was archived.

Unlike Tern-4, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Plover-4 is the Prism team. Nobody should assume the owner of Plover-4 applies to Tern-4, the owner differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Pages from Dunlin-6 land on the pager rotation of Wendell Galloway before anyone else. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
